text: The rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has substantially expanded the range of tasks they can address. In the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP), researchers have shifted their focus from conventional NLP tasks (e.g., sequence tagging and parsing) towards tasks that revolve around aligning with human needs (e.g., brainstorming and email writing).
In this paper, we propose a generative judge with 13B parameters, **Auto-J**, designed to address these challenges.
To demonstrate the efficacy of our approach, we construct a new testbed covering 58 different scenarios.
We also provide detailed analysis and case studies to further reveal the potential of our method and make a variety of resources public at https://github.com/GAIR-NLP/auto-j.
